# LVMH

> > LVMH is the world's leading luxury goods group, encompassing prestigious maisons across fashion, leather goods, perfumes, watches, jewelry, and media, with a commitment to craftsmanship, innovation, and sustainability.

LVMH (Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton) unites over 75 exceptional houses including Louis Vuitton, Christian Dior Couture, Givenchy, LOEWE, TAG Heuer, and Le Parisien. The group combines heritage craftsmanship with contemporary creativity, led by visionaries like Pharrell Williams, Jonathan Anderson, and Sarah Burton, while maintaining strong investor relations and sustainability initiatives through programs like LIFE 360.
